## Recent vs Prior Window (code-computed deltas)

Deltas are recent minus prior; positive = higher in the recent window.

- 4-Seam Fastball: velo +0.4 mph, S+ +7, L+ +7, usage +12.2 pts, release x +0.10 ft, release z -0.14 ft, extension +0.09 ft
- Cutter: velo +0.9 mph, S+ +15, L+ -2, usage -3.0 pts, release x +0.12 ft, release z -0.11 ft, extension +0.06 ft
- Sweeper: velo +1.1 mph, S+ +22, L+ +37, usage -5.0 pts, release x +0.08 ft, release z -0.05 ft, extension +0.06 ft
- Changeup: insufficient sample for a recent-vs-prior delta

Release-point or extension and velocity changed in the same comparison. That association is consistent with a possible adjustment, but these aggregates do not identify a mechanism or establish a cause-and-effect relationship between the changes.
